detail.flavor: You've scraped by in the harsh wasteland and know how to stay alive against the odds. Choose two traits from the Survivor list, or one trait and one extra starting perk.
detail.benefit: Pick 2 traits OR 1 trait + 1 extra perk at creation.
detail.penalty: No fixed origin trait — your build is defined by trait choices.

detail.flavor: Sheltered life underground left you educated but unprepared for the world above. You gain an extra tag skill and the Vault Kid origin trait.
detail.benefit: +1 extra tag skill. Vault Kid trait.
detail.penalty: END tests to resist disease are increased by 1 DC.

detail.flavor: Radiation changed your body forever. Survival is always a tag skill at rank 2. You endure where others would perish.
detail.benefit: Survival is a tag skill (+2 ranks). Radiation resistance and long life.
detail.penalty: Social penalties; some equipment packs restricted (Wastelander packs allowed).

detail.flavor: You serve the Brotherhood's mission to recover and preserve pre-war technology. Your extra tag skill is limited to Energy Weapons, Science, or Repair.
detail.benefit: +1 extra tag skill (Energy Weapons, Science, or Repair only). Brotherhood equipment pack.
detail.penalty: Bound by Brotherhood codes and expectations.

detail.flavor: Infected with the Forced Evolutionary Virus (F.E.V.), your body has mutated into a tall, muscular killing machine. You may hail from the Master’s army, Vault 87, the Institute’s experiments, or Huntersville’s contaminated water — each strain rarely mixing with the others.
detail.benefit: Forced Evolution: STR and END start at 7 (+2 each); max STR/END 12; immune to radiation and poison.
detail.penalty: Max INT/CHA 6; skills max rank 3 at creation (4 later); only super mutant–fitted armor.

detail.flavor: A General Atomics domestic automaton (Mister Handy, Gutsy, Miss Nanny, or Orderly line) with jet propulsion, three arms, and self-determination that carried you past the Great War.
detail.benefit: Mister Handy Robot: 360° vision; rad/poison immune; hover over terrain; three arm attachments from your pack (weapon arms include 20 ammo).
detail.penalty: No chems, food, or rest; 150 lb. carry weight (fixed); heal only via repairs; robot hit locations.
